subject: Deploy Candidate 01 uniform 8:5 motion rhythm
body: Repoint only the local Doré Design resident to Candidate 01 head b9de8f61575bfdd50c0ff996565b8f1a7f385078. Preserve Candidate 01, Visual Director, 4W labels, and the pointer-leave collapse fix. argv: html=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01'); printf '%s' "$html" | grep -q 'candidate-01-living-editorial-runtime'; printf '%s' "$html" | grep -q 'flex-grow:1!important'; printf '%s' "$html" | grep -q 'aspect-ratio:8/5!important'; printf '%s' "$html" | grep -q 'leaveOutsideActive'; ! printf '%s' "$html" | grep -q 'flex-grow:2.35!important'; ! printf '%s' "$html" | grep -q 'aspect-ratio:5/8!important'
